## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cūḷarathavimānavatthu* (Vv 63, also referenced as Vv 5.13) is a canonical text belonging to the *Vimānavatthu* collection [Radich 2007]. It recounts the story of Prince Sujāta, who renounced household life for the forest and was ordained into the holy life by the arahant Mahā-Kaccāna [Radich 2007]. Perceiving that the prince had only five months left to live, Mahā-Kaccāna urged him to generate merit; by learning the Dhamma and transforming his conduct prior to death, the prince secured a celestial rebirth [Radich 2007].
